name: @mosvera/runtime
description: Reference runtime for Mosvera — a declarative runtime for aesthetic intent. Parses, resolves inheritance, merges modifiers, composes primitives, and applies the provider compilation contract. Zero runtime dependencies; pure semantic core.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-schemas.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
